name: BankrollNetworkStack self-funded buyFor inflation
summary: buyFor() accepted the pool itself as the beneficiary. WBNB.transferFrom(pool, pool, amount) was balance-neutral, but purchaseTokens() still minted internal stake and allocated virtual fees. Repeating that self-funded buy inflated dividends owed to the attacker's real stake, which sell() and withdraw() paid from the pool's WBNB reserve.

loss.notes: The exploit receipt records 16,000 WBNB entering BankrollNetworkStack and 16,412.459593848661728154 WBNB leaving it. The exact transaction-local reserve depletion is therefore 412.459593848661728154 WBNB; the attacker's 404.459593848661728154 WBNB receipt is lower because 8 WBNB repaid the flash-loan fee. DefiLlama observed BNB at $580.89 at timestamp 1727023800, 58 seconds before the exploit.

ageReset.description: The direct BankrollNetworkStack runtime was created in this transaction and remained the execution artifact through the exploit.

sources.note: Reviewed the exploit transaction, receipt and full call trace; the direct deployment; runtime history; extracted verified source; and historical BNB price. Attacker EOA 0x4645863205b47a0a3344684489e8c446a437d66c called 0x8f921e27e3af106015d1c3a244ec4f48dbfcad14, which created helper 0x40122cecaaad5dd1c1da4d8cec42120565c547d7 with CREATE2. The helper flash-borrowed 16,000 WBNB, bought a real Bankroll stake, then made 2,810 buyFor(pool, 16413.345861143662308303 WBNB) calls. Each WBNB transfer was pool-to-pool and balance-neutral, while purchaseTokens still increased internal supply and allocateFees increased profitPerShare and the dividend pool. The helper then sold its real stake and withdrew the inflated dividend. Receipt transfers show the pool received 16,000 WBNB and paid 16,412.459593848661728154 WBNB, an exact depletion of 412.459593848661728154 WBNB; 8 WBNB of this paid the flash fee and 404.459593848661728154 WBNB reached the attacker EOA. BankrollNetworkStack was created top-level by 0xcb71eb21f53a2f4de0f26dc90518df10be13d1ec at block 5546763:32. Its 5,676-byte runtime first appears there and hashes to 0x794fcb07c88993ce10935a43f867ea7905f0b99aa0fe1e2a630d4d03b9e7e44a both at creation and immediately before the exploit; the exploit executes it directly without DELEGATECALL. DefiLlama's preceding BNB observation was $580.89 at timestamp 1727023800.
